She described finding yoga calming and expressed that giving people peace and awareness brings her happiness, and that teaching has helped her build community connections and make friends. Jolene then disclosed she is struggling to keep up with her engineering assignments and asked to discuss time management. Deborah offered support and they agreed to find a time to talk.
